name: Commercial Steam Cleaner
definition: A professional cleaning machine that heats water to generate steam delivered through an approved hose and tool, with selected models also providing integrated vacuum recovery and/or a controlled detergent function.
includedScope: Steam, vacuum and detergent machines where the exact configuration supports those functions
excludedScope: Pressure washers without a steam-cleaning function
Medical sterilizers and validated sterilization processes
Broad disinfection claims without exact method evidence
primaryApplications: Kitchen and sanitary-area cleaning within material limits
Steam-and-vacuum recovery tasks on approved surfaces
headline: Commercial steam cleaner types, pressure and temperature boundaries, recovery systems and buyer verification
description: This technical profile separates steam-only, steam-and-vacuum and detergent-capable architectures, explains specification and hygiene-claim boundaries, and provides model and procurement checks.
metaDescription: Commercial steam cleaner guide covering steam-only and steam-vacuum types, pressure, temperature, components, models and procurement checks.
disclaimer: This is an independent category reference, not model-specific purchasing, disinfection, infection-control, chemical, electrical-safety or repair advice. Confirm the exact machine, validated method, surface compatibility, utilities, regional compliance and service terms.

keyFacts.label: Architecture boundary
keyFacts.value: Steam-only, steam-and-vacuum, and steam-vacuum-detergent are distinct systems
keyFacts.evidence: Official manufacturer sources document these different functions.
keyFacts.scope: Named machines; no family-wide feature inference.

keyFacts.label: Published pressure
keyFacts.value: Reviewed professional models publish source-defined steam pressures from 4 bar to 8 bar
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturer pages and data sheets state model-specific pressure values.
keyFacts.scope: Named configurations; pressure alone is not cleaning outcome.

keyFacts.label: Hygiene-claim boundary
keyFacts.value: A disinfection result requires the exact validated method, organism, surface, contact conditions and jurisdiction
keyFacts.evidence: Kärcher states a method-specific floor result under defined nozzle, speed, steam and VapoHydro conditions; TASKI states source-specific thermal conditions.
keyFacts.scope: Only the cited tests and conditions; no general disinfection or sterilization claim.

keyFacts.label: Performance-method boundary
keyFacts.value: IEC 62885-5 lists characteristic performance parameters for covered high-pressure and steam cleaners
keyFacts.scope: Measurement framework, not a minimum result or hygiene validation.

systemFlow.name: Water supply
systemFlow.componentFamily: Reservoir, fill system and level controls
systemFlow.role: Supplies clean water to the steam generator.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer data identifies reservoir and continuous-fill arrangements.
systemFlow.scope: Approved water quality and fill method are machine-specific.

systemFlow.name: Steam generation
systemFlow.role: Heats water and maintains controlled steam pressure.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources publish boiler, heater, pressure or temperature data.
systemFlow.scope: Source values may be boiler-side rather than tool-contact conditions.

systemFlow.name: Steam delivery
systemFlow.componentFamily: Steam hose, handle, valves and tools
systemFlow.role: Transfers and applies steam to the target surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Official manuals and product sources document hoses, controls and accessories.

systemFlow.name: Soil interaction
systemFlow.componentFamily: Nozzle, brush, cloth and operating method
systemFlow.role: Combines heat, moisture, agitation and dwell or travel conditions at the surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer method statements tie results to exact accessories and operating conditions.
systemFlow.scope: Actual surface, soil and validated method.

systemFlow.name: Optional recovery
systemFlow.componentFamily: Vacuum motor, hose and recovery tank
systemFlow.role: Recovers loosened soil and moisture on steam-vacuum models.
systemFlow.evidence: Kärcher, TASKI and Lavor document integrated vacuum configurations.

variants.name: Steam-only cleaner
variants.taskScale: Detail and hard-surface cleaning where separate wiping or collection is acceptable
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator applies steam through hose and tools
variants.spaceConstraints: Requires water, power and hot-hose management
variants.limitations: No integrated soil or moisture recovery.
variants.evidence: Kärcher SG 4/4 and IPC SG-08 are documented steam-generator formats.

variants.name: Steam-and-vacuum cleaner
variants.taskScale: Cleaning where immediate recovery supports the workflow
variants.operatorRelationship: Operator manages steam and suction functions plus recovery emptying
variants.spaceConstraints: Larger system, more hoses and recovery capacity
variants.limitations: Integrated vacuum does not establish universal surface or hygiene suitability.
variants.evidence: Kärcher SGV, TASKI SV4 and IPC SG-30 document steam-and-vacuum functions.

variants.name: Steam, vacuum and detergent cleaner
variants.taskScale: Heavy professional workflows requiring controlled chemical assistance
variants.operatorRelationship: Adds detergent fill, dosing and rinse procedures
variants.spaceConstraints: Requires chemical storage, compatibility and recovery controls
variants.limitations: Detergent capability does not prove food-contact, disinfection or discharge approval.
variants.evidence: Lavor GV Etna-R and TASKI's commercial range distinguish detergent-capable formats.

performanceMetrics.name: Steam pressure
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Describes source-defined boiler or working pressure
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Working, maximum and boiler pressure terms must be matched
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Pressure alone does not determine heat or cleaning result at the surface.

performanceMetrics.name: Temperature
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Boiler, steam exit and contact-point temperatures are different
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not transfer one measurement location to another.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official sources publish values at different stated boundaries.

performanceMetrics.name: Steam output
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: May be stated as maximum mass flow or output rate
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Output settings, accessories and method change surface moisture.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IPC and Lavor publish source-defined steam output.

performanceMetrics.name: Heat-up and continuous fill
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Initial heat-up and refill recovery are different
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A continuous-fill label does not eliminate water or maintenance stops.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Kärcher and TASKI publish heat-up or continuous-fill features.

performanceMetrics.name: Recovery airflow and capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Supports soil and moisture handling on steam-vacuum machines
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Vacuum power, airflow, water lift and tank capacity are different metrics
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official steam-vacuum data publishes recovery-system parameters.

applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers position reviewed machines for floors, fixtures, joints and difficult surfaces.
applicationFit.scope: Heat- and moisture-compatible surfaces within instructions.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Tool geometry, heat, moisture, wiping or recovery and achieved result must be trialled together.
applicationFit.basis: Complete steam-delivery architecture and official use positioning.
applicationFit.limitations: No universal surface safety or soil-removal result is established.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Trial representative surfaces and document tool, setting, passes, moisture and damage checks.

applicationFit.evidence: Official sources position professional steam machines for hygienic or demanding cleaning contexts.
applicationFit.scope: Approved surfaces, soils and local procedures.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Heat sensitivity, grease load, food-contact controls, runoff and recovery determine fit.
applicationFit.basis: Manufacturer application positioning and system functions.
applicationFit.limitations: No food-contact or disinfection approval is inferred.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Obtain surface, chemical, hygiene and wastewater approval for the exact method.

applicationFit.evidence: Kärcher, TASKI, IPC and Lavor document integrated vacuum models.
applicationFit.scope: Exact steam-vacuum machine and approved pickup.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Recovery may reduce residual moisture but adds tank, filter, hose and emptying requirements.
applicationFit.limitations: No universal drying-time result was reviewed.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Measure residual moisture and recovery workflow on the actual task.

applicationFit.evidence: Available manufacturer claims are tied to specified conditions and source-specific methods.
applicationFit.scope: Only exact validated organism, surface, accessory, setting, speed or contact conditions.
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: A steam cleaner should not be purchased for a hygiene claim unless the complete method matches the requirement.
applicationFit.limitations: This profile claims neither general disinfection nor sterilization.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Require the full test report, applicable standard, organism, log reduction, surface and operating protocol.

componentStack.evidence: Official sources document different fill architectures.

componentStack.evidence: Official manuals identify model-specific steam accessories.

componentStack.evidence: Official sources document recovery systems on selected machines.

componentStack.role: Powers heaters, vacuum motors and optional dosing functions.
componentStack.evidence: Official sources publish electrical and optional detergent functions.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Surface result, heat and moisture compatibility, tool and recovery method
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Selecting by pressure or boiler temperature alone
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish different tools, pressures, temperatures and recovery systems.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Specify a result-based trial with damage and residual-moisture checks.
procurementDecisions.basis: Surface outcome depends on the complete delivery and operating method.
procurementDecisions.limitations: WCB has not independently compared cleaning performance.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Trial representative surfaces and record tool, setting, passes, time, water and recovery.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm hose, seals, tool, boiler rating, fill system and electrical load.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Recovery effectiveness, tank handling and hose sanitation
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming integrated vacuum guarantees a dry or hygienic result
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturer sources identify integrated recovery but do not establish a universal result.
procurementDecisions.scope: Exact machine, surface and operating method.
procurementDecisions.assessment: The trial must include fill, recovery, emptying and end-of-shift cleaning.
procurementDecisions.basis: Recovery system adds both capability and maintenance interfaces.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No normalized drying or hygiene comparison was reviewed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Measure residual moisture and document recovery-tank and hose cleaning.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify vacuum motor, recovery filter, tank, drain, hose and approved pickup.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Full validated method and applicability to the required organism and surface
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Using steam temperature as automatic disinfection proof
procurementDecisions.evidence: Reviewed claims are tied to source-specific test conditions.
procurementDecisions.scope: Exact method, surface, organism, machine and jurisdiction.
procurementDecisions.assessment: Do not specify a hygiene outcome unless every required condition is documented and operationally repeatable.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No general disinfection or sterilization claim is made.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Require and review the complete test protocol and implementation controls.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm tool, steam setting, contact or travel conditions, water quality, monitoring and records.

engineeringChecks.reason: Boiler, hose, valves, seals and tools operate with hot pressurized steam.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify exact approved part numbers and inspection or replacement intervals.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official manuals identify model-specific steam systems and safety instructions.
engineeringChecks.scope: No visual or cross-brand compatibility inference.

engineeringChecks.reason: Mineral loading and incorrect fill media can affect boiler operation and service.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Obtain the manufacturer's water, descaling and maintenance requirements.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official manuals define fill and maintenance procedures.
engineeringChecks.scope: Actual water supply and exact model.

engineeringChecks.reason: Heater and optional vacuum loads must match the site circuit and regional configuration.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Confirm voltage, frequency, plug, connected load, cable and water access.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer data publishes electrical values for named machines.

engineeringChecks.reason: Heat, moisture, detergent and dwell can damage surfaces or fail the required hygiene outcome.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Approve the full method through material testing and applicable hygiene review.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer evidence is method- and configuration-specific.
engineeringChecks.scope: Actual surface, chemical, organism and jurisdiction.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-79:2021
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements covering specified high-pressure cleaners and steam cleaners.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the equipment scope and exclusions.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and exact product conformity.

standards.name: IEC 62885-5:2018
standards.applicability: Methods for describing characteristic performance parameters of household and commercial high-pressure cleaners and steam cleaners within the stated scope.
standards.scope: It does not validate hygiene claims or make unmatched catalogue values comparable.

developments.title: Steam-cleaner safety edition published
developments.summary: IEC published edition 5.0 of IEC 60335-2-79 covering the stated high-pressure-cleaner and steam-cleaner safety scope.
developments.evidence: The IEC catalogue records the edition and publication date.
developments.scope: International base standard; regional adoption differs.

developments.title: Steam-cleaner performance-method standard published
developments.summary: IEC published IEC 62885-5 to list characteristic performance parameters for covered high-pressure and steam cleaners.
developments.evidence: The IEC catalogue records the publication scope and date.
developments.scope: Measurement framework, not a cleaning or hygiene ranking.
